title: Challenge 6 Quiz - Trading Psychology & Emotional Discipline
description: Test your understanding of trading psychology, emotional control, discipline, patience, consistency and developing a professional trading mindset.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of trading psychology?
questions.explanation: Trading psychology focuses on recognizing and controlling emotions so decisions remain disciplined.

questions.question: Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) usually causes traders to:
options: Chase trades after price has already moved
questions.explanation: FOMO encourages traders to enter late because they fear missing an opportunity.

questions.question: Revenge trading normally happens after:
options: An emotional loss that the trader wants to recover immediately
questions.explanation: Revenge trading is driven by emotion and the desire to recover losses quickly.

questions.question: According to this course, traders should generally aim for an average risk-to-reward ratio of:
questions.explanation: The course recommends an average risk-to-reward ratio of approximately 1:3 whenever market conditions support it.

questions.question: What is the maximum total trading risk allowed during one trading session in this course?
questions.explanation: The course teaches that total session risk must never exceed 5% of trading capital.

questions.question: Patience in trading means:
options: Waiting for valid setups that match the trading plan
questions.explanation: Patience means waiting for quality opportunities instead of forcing trades.

questions.question: Which behaviour best demonstrates trading discipline?
options: Increasing risk after every profitable trade
Following the trading plan even after a losing trade
Removing stop-losses when price approaches them
questions.explanation: Discipline means following established rules regardless of recent results.

questions.question: Professional traders primarily measure long-term success by:
options: Consistent execution, discipline and risk management
Taking the highest number of trades
questions.explanation: Professionals focus on process and consistency rather than individual trade outcomes.

questions.question: A trading journal is mainly used to:
options: Record trades and identify behavioural patterns
questions.explanation: A journal helps traders review performance, identify mistakes and improve discipline.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects a professional trading mindset?
options: Large profits are more important than risk control.
Capital preservation comes before capital growth.
The market can always be predicted.
questions.explanation: Professional traders focus first on protecting capital, then on growing it responsibly.
